title: Skeletal System
ques: What are the two main functions of the human skeleton?

answer.content:
The two main functions of the skeleton are:
1. To provide **shape and support** to the body so we can stand up straight.
2. To **protect internal organs** (for example, the skull protects the brain, and the ribcage protects the heart and lungs).

explanation: This covers the primary biological roles of the skeletal system.

title: Types of Joints
ques: Your shoulder can move in a full circle, but your knee can only bend back and forth like a door. Name the types of joints found in your shoulder and in your knee.

answer.content:
*   The shoulder has a **Ball and Socket joint**, which allows movement in all directions.
*   The knee has a **Hinge joint**, which only allows movement in one direction.

explanation: This requires identifying specific joint types based on their range of motion.

title: Animal Movement
ques: An earthworm does not have any bones. How does an earthworm move forward through the soil?

answer.content: An earthworm moves using its **muscles** and tiny bristles under its body. It stretches the front part of its body forward, grips the soil with the bristles, and then pulls the back part of its body forward.

explanation: This compares human skeletal movement with invertebrate muscular movement.
